thread:
marta: Heads up, after installing redwoodctl via brew on my M1 runner, `redwoodctl login` errors out until I move some files around.

marta: Minimal repro:
```
$ which redwoodctl
/opt/homebrew/bin/redwoodctl
$ redwoodctl login --profile testci
Error: cannot open token store: open /usr/local/Cellar/redwoodctl/0.14.2/libexec/cache/tokens.json: permission denied
```

marta: The binary is the /opt/homebrew one but the token cache is under /usr/local Cellar and owned by root. CI user can't write there so login fails.

jake: Looks like the formula or build step created a runtime cache during packaging (bad). Short-term options: set REDWOOD_CONFIG to a writable path, or move the cache to $HOME/.redwood and chown. Example:
```
export REDWOOD_CONFIG=$HOME/.redwood
mkdir -p $REDWOOD_CONFIG && sudo mv /usr/local/.../tokens.json $REDWOOD_CONFIG/ && sudo chown $USER $REDWOOD_CONFIG/tokens.json
```

marta: That worked locally. In CI I did `export REDWOOD_CONFIG=$RUNNER_TEMP/.redwood` before running login and tests passed.

lia: We should update the brew formula: don't create user runtime files in Cellar at package build time. Add a postinstall that only scaffolds user files when run interactively as that user, or document env vars as the supported override.

jake: Also: the zsh completion leftover from /usr/local/share/zsh/site-functions was autoloading and suggested flags not present in the installed binary. People get confused when completion and binary disagree.

marta: Yes — I saw `--enable-legacy-auth` suggested by completion but the current binary doesn't accept it.

lia: For devex docs: add a section "Mac M1/Homebrew caveats" with clear remediation: prefer `/opt/homebrew` installs, remove stale completions in `/usr/local/share/zsh/site-functions`, or set REDWOOD_CONFIG. We should also add a brief `redwoodctl doctor` enhancement to detect stale Cellar copies and permissions issues and suggest fixes.

jake: Filed devex-bot issue #4890: "brew formula creates runtime cache under Cellar causing perms issues on mac-arm" (assignee: jake). Please attach brew info and `ls -l` of the path.

marta: One tiny DX idea: when `redwoodctl` fails to open a token file, print the path and a one-liner hint (e.g., `Hint: set REDWOOD_CONFIG or move tokens.json to $HOME/.redwood`) — saved my afternoon.

lia: Adding that to the CLI improvements backlog. Also adding a CI test so future formulas won't assume write access to Cellar.

marta: Workaround in my dotfiles now:
```
export REDWOOD_CONFIG=$HOME/.redwood
# remove stale completions
rm -f /usr/local/share/zsh/site-functions/_redwoodctl || true
```

marta: Thanks — reopening if I hit anything else. :thumbsup:
